about: Claude (VRG Mobile, WP M22): where a paired phone may start a Claude Remote Control session on the PC. Read by Planner/projects/varler-planner/tools/relay-claude.js, only when the relay runs with --claude. The folders are START's own Claude Code menu (launcher/vrg-menu.json, start.dev C); this file names which of its keys the phone may use. The phone never sends a path, a name or a command: a key and an account letter.

folders.about: START -> C item keys. Not here: B (Bernard, an agent with its own arguments).

accounts.about: The Desktop's Claude profiles (Dashboard/config/profiles.json): A = claude-a, B = claude-b (its own CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR).
